notes: Weak in probing: 0.11-0.31 on four mechanism sentences against 0.01-0.03 on plain narrative, so ranking is clean but the size is low and the 0.20 median may fail. The - pole fires on ' by' / ' through' / ' because', the explicit means-and-cause connectives; this + side looks like the looser slot around them.
